name: Felix Perigrie
title: Counsellor
description: I work with neurodivergent, LGBTIQA+, and other marginalised folks who are feeling overwhelmed, exhausted, and burnt out, and together, we find new ways to respond to challenges they face. As a queer, neurodivergent therapist I’ve spent years discovering how the stories we tell ourselves feel so solid and unshakable, yet crumble when we start to question who benefits from our self-hatred, and figure out what we really want.

name: Lam Trieu Luong
title: Counsellor
description: Many people seek counselling when they’re navigating the effects of trauma, chronic stress, or complex relationships. With a trauma‑informed, humanistic, and strengths‑based approach I aim to help clients understand what’s happening inside them, develop practical coping strategies and reconnect with their values and direction. I work through an intersectional, trauma‑informed lens, with safety and trust at the centre of the process. As a non‑binary, queer, neurodivergent counsellor from a multicultural background, I understand how important it is to feel genuinely seen and safe.

title: Social Worker
description: I've worked with people of all genders, sexualities, cultures and abilities. This led to me becoming more interested in the universality of trauma and PTSD.
